title: SDFGI render-pass uniform set provides the material feedback buffer at binding 37 instead of 38
expected_finding: the MODE_RENDER_SDF shader writes MaterialFeedbackBuffer at set 1 binding 38, but _setup_sdfgi_render_pass_uniform_set (and so the set-1 layout) provides the feedback storage buffer at binding 37; binding 38 is not in the layout
